a
ssin⁡2t−4t2sin2⁡s
b
2s2sin2⁡t+2tsin⁡2s
c
2ssin2⁡t−2t2sin⁡2s
d
2scos2⁡t−2tsin⁡2s
e
s2sin⁡2t+4tsin2⁡s
